summary: Wetour Robotics Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting that it convened an Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders on August 4, 2026, but immediately adjourned it indefinitely without conducting business other than approving the adjournment. The meeting was called to approve proposals in the definitive proxy statement filed July 16, 2026, but no details of those proposals or reasons for adjournment are provided. This is a routine procedural update regarding a shareholder meeting, not a substantive special-situation event. The filing also incorporates the report into existing registration statements. No financial terms, board actions, or strategic transactions are disclosed, so the event does not qualify as a special situation under the specified categories.
